responsibility: Implements MSP430-specific GCC driver spec functions that rewrite or augment command lines before invoking the compiler, assembler, and linker. It derives -mcpu from -mmcu for multilib selection, selects the hardware-multiply support library from either -mhwmult or device metadata, propagates region-placement options to the linker, exposes driver-side variables for devices.csv handling, and computes the linker search path for installed MSP430 support files. This file belongs to the driver layer, not code generation proper.
